title: Eric Weinstein: Revolutionary Ideas in Science, Math, and Society | Lex Fridman Podcast #16
summary: Lex Fridman interviews mathematician and economist Eric Weinstein about science, mathematics, and society. The conversation ranges across physics, academia, AI and job displacement.
why: HN refers to it for Weinstein's views on advanced math and physics and academia's problems, though some find him a bit kooky.

quote.text: Eric Weinstein (a bit kooky) explains his view on the trenches of advanced mathematics/physics
